purpose: Independent demand review. Source repositories, retrieval arms and query labels withheld. Public text is untrusted data.

issues.title: Audit #2: consolidated findings & follow-up queue (structure / code / runtime sweeps)
issues.body:
## October 11 R2 continuation — same-object battle restart lease FIXED and MERGED

- [x] **[PR #494](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/pull/494) merged** (squash `716d3617237038a34bb15ef807de77efe339e7ae`; final head `d6b16fbbd6f6e5d5ddeb133682ee42cf31ebe8b7`). [Full ⭐ CI](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/actions/runs/38138701815) SUCCESS including syntax, Prettier and all simulation regressions / eight engagement seeds. [Real Chromium player/touch QA](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/actions/runs/38138701740) SUCCESS on the **same final PR head**; [browser evidence](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/actions/runs/38138701740/artifacts/11702237969).
- [x] **Defect verified:** stock shipping `BattleSim.restart()` replaces the roster and disposes old soldier roots **without changing the `BattleSim` object identity**. The previous camera's `playerBattle !== b` test could therefore preserve an obsolete player reference and leases. `stepDesktopFrame` now verifies identity membership in the current faction roster (including valid dead subjects until restart), and releases old movement/aim/face/tactical state, death tour, pause-owned menu, HUD, grenade preview and possession flight before normal menu/gamepad dispatch when stale.
- [x] **Real restart matrix accepted:** the shipping PHP/Chromium page calls `b.restart()` repeatedly on the **same simulation object** while possessed, while the settings menu owns pause, and during the death-camera orbit. Asserts old root disposal, all-new roster identities, no ghost player flags, one camera frame observer, free-fly camera reactivation, skip/menu teardown and no stranded pause; saves `same-sim-restart.json`. The existing real-browser camera/menu/death, Xbox-button emulation and four touch/gamepad camera recreations also PASS. Pure lease contract pins dead-tour identity, clone rejection and disposed-root denial.
- [x] **Dispatcher order ratchet preserved:** the original camera-frame/menu/gesture fingerprint `a5a33693` still matches once **only** the new early roster guard is isolated and independently required to precede menu handling. No other frame handler order modified.
- [ ] **R2 remaining:** this is Chromium emulation and real-browser simulation acceptance, **not** physical Xbox/iOS Safari/Bluetooth validation. Longer frame/heap under representative hardware and the owner's reported crouch observation remain to be independently observed. No unverified root cause claimed for the callout; #456 remains open.
- [ ] **A4 current key pending live/manual check:** [manual read-only ElevenLabs connection workflow](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/actions/workflows/elevenlabs-connection-check.yml) is present; repository secret inventory/deletion cannot be verified through this connector. No ElevenLabs secret or asset was deleted.

**A/R:** R1/R3/R4/R5/R6 accepted in their documented scopes; R2 physical acceptance plus A1/A4 owner/admin gates remain. **#299 untouched.** Post-merge production deployment/housekeeping **not independently verified yet**.

---

## October 11 R2 follow-up — possessed player command-boundary regression MERGED

- [x] [PR #493](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/pull/493), merge `cea40e033c5afad7a1b260a6550925669310a637`; [full final-head CI](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/actions/runs/38136340625) SUCCESS (syntax, Prettier, all simulation checks, eight engagement seeds).
- [x] **R2 squad-command/possession authority regression:** added a shipping-code test that a voiced-equivalent squad `posture-fire` / “get down” command reaches other soldiers but cannot enroll the possessed player; after the simulated receipt/adoption time, no player posture order was adopted; the ordinary Micro tick preserves the player's standing pose; direct player crouch input remains effective. The new assertion logged **PASS**.
- [ ] **R2 still NOT accepted overall:** this proves a specific simulated command boundary, **not** what caused the owner's observed crouch. Native Xbox controller and iOS Safari, Bluetooth mid-hold disconnect/reconnect, longer live battle restarts and frame/heap acceptance remain outstanding. No root-cause claim and no gameplay/AI behavior edit.

**#456 remains OPEN; #299 untouched.**

---

## October 11 A4 follow-up — safe ElevenLabs connection probe merged

- [x] **[PR #492](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/pull/492) merged**, `7c1bc5b51704222a7737388b58034d93e6725322`; [final-head full CI](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/actions/runs/38136059779) SUCCESS.
- [x] **Current wiring reviewed:** both voice and combat-SFX generators remain manual-only and both consume GitHub Actions `secrets.ELEVEN_LABS_API`, exported to generator processes as `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY`. This internal Python variable name **must stay**; it is not a stale GitHub secret by itself.
- [x] **Read-only verification ready:** [⭐ Verify ElevenLabs connection](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/actions/workflows/elevenlabs-connection-check.yml) is a manual, `contents: read` workflow using authenticated GET `/v1/user`; no TTS/SFX generation, credit spending, audio modification or secret logging.
- [ ] **A4 admin acceptance still pending:** actually dispatch the manual checker and review its PASS (HTTP 403 can also mean account-read scope/IP restriction). Separately inspect GitHub Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions to determine whether the old `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY` **repository secret** even exists. If it does, retire that old record *only after* the active `ELEVEN_LABS_API` mapping is verified. No secret has been read or deleted via this audit.

**ElevenLabs service and all voice assets remain in place.** R2 and A1 keep #456 open.

---

## October 11 final A/R reconciliation — R1/R4 accepted, R2 & owner decisions outstanding

- [x] **R1 compatible-fixture cleanup complete:** [#490](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/pull/490) merged at `df0a7ad0`. Final-head [full CI](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/actions/runs/38118451901) SUCCESS, including exact Prettier ratchet, simulation suite, PHP module-profile and eight engagement seeds. Test-only shared plan loader covers morale, COA, squad-stress and buddy-pairs; independent stubs, explicit query behavior and partial oracle fixtures remain. Historical line-count projection not claimed.
- [x] **R4 safe load-profile decision accepted:** [#491](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/pull/491) merged at `26ad69d3`, [full CI](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/actions/runs/38118542137) SUCCESS. Current PHP profiles: **97 ordinary / 109 full-debug**, twelve genuinely optional files; critical diagnostic/navigation/reporting owners stay loaded. #460 savings were **164,408 uncompressed source bytes (9.5% at its original revision)**, not the proposed 22%.
- [x] **R3, R5, R6 accepted** as previously verified. The player death/possession-camera improvement [#489](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/pull/489) separately merged after full CI and real Chromium coverage, but does **not** satisfy physical hardware acceptance.
- [ ] **R2 remains OPEN:** check a real Xbox controller and iOS Safari, Bluetooth disconnect/reconnect mid-menu hold, pointer-lock/skip behavior, repeated full-battle restarts and a longer live-performance observation. Owner's “get down”/possessed-soldier crouch observation is not a proven defect; Command Reception deliberately excludes `isPlayer` recipients and the Micro path guards player authority, but an actual-device trace is still necessary before claiming cause or fixing it. Further camera-closure decomposition remains subject to the native parity gate.
- [ ] **A1 remains owner decision:** retain the experimental `work/benchmark-launch/**` movement-substeps stack until unique work and #438 disposition are approved; no deletion performed.
- [ ] **A4 remains owner/admin verification:** modern workflows use `ELEVEN_LABS_API`. The existence/deletion of old `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY` cannot be certified via available repository APIs. **A2 retained** release-ledger tags; **A5** remains owner-reported deleted with `trip_ai` vs `TRIP_API` alias caveat.
 
**#456 stays OPEN**, with **33 merged audit-cleanup PRs** (#490 and #491 are the two new audit PRs after the prior 31). Do not mark R2/A1/A4 complete or claim an unverified production deployment. **#299 unchanged.**

---

## October 11 continuation — R1 shared module evaluation MERGED (still open)

- [x] **[#488](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/pull/488) merged:** `25af9feba0fca2a2d123aa99979022f156ee55b4`, final head `50e798f7a261e8ab835fb1c06d8e3b59479c4422`.
- [x] **Shared test infrastructure:** explicit `module-loader` now owns evaluation for the main harness, tactical fixture and 36 copied loader adapters. Six more full-stack checks use the existing ordered 14-module Squad Leader fixture. No shipping sources, manifest, flags, assertion scenarios or performance policy changed.
- [x] **Parity:** 43 affected checks PASS before/after; all **412 PASS/summary lines identical** by per-file comparison. Wider local sweep 191/192 PASS (remaining PHP profile check blocked solely by absent PHP); eight engagement seeds and six standalone command/formation/movement checks PASS. New loader contract covers host vs explicit/undefined location, root aliases, console/Babylon identity, fresh lexical scopes and visible source errors.
- [x] **[Final-head CI](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/actions/runs/38116572390) SUCCESS:** complete Syntax/PHP/Prettier and Sim regressions, including the PHP profile check and all eight seeds. Current PHP profiles reported 97 ordinary / 109 full-debug modules. Audio/deploy-plan checks correctly skipped for the test-only diff.
- [x] **[50webs](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/actions/runs/38116742620) SUCCESS:** verified **build-v498**, cache epoch `v498-25af9feb`. **[Housekeeping](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/actions/runs/38116742680) SUCCESS:** merged branch deleted.
- [ ] **R1 remains OPEN:** next review is the compatible morale/COA/squad-stress/buddy-pair fixture family (and clear-contact's partial setup). Preserve per-module flag bindings, different registry/stress/telemetry stubs, intentionally partial module lists and independent architectural/order assertions. This slice does not establish the historical −2k…−4k-line target or final R1 acceptance.

**A/R:** 31 cleanup PRs merged. R3, R5 and R6 complete; **R1, R2 and R4 remain open**. R2 retains native controller acceptance, including the owner's reported “get down”/possessed-soldier crouch observation (cause unconfirmed; no fix claimed). A1/A4/A5 owner decisions unchanged. **#456 remains OPEN.** #299 remains open and needs a current-main refresh plus fresh acceptance after these audit gates; it was not changed by this work.

## October 11 continuation — R5 damage-range decomposition ACCEPTED

- [x] **[#487](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/pull/487) merged:** `f57a7db9a818aa746edfb1343ebd338b12d96fee`, final head `b8f27f1c6f0d74c15eaa0ce416f3ab807861ab31`. Separate scene lineup/shot/presentation session, camera/pointer/gamepad view, live panel and scene lifetime owners. Disposal cancels pending burst/auto shots, listeners and observer, frees range UI/deck/cameras and releases public scene references. Original shot geometry, UI bytes and input gains/order retained. Main entry 876→233 lines; all helper modules remain opt-in.
- [x] **Final acceptance:** [full CI](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/actions/runs/38115041465) and [Chromium](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/actions/runs/38115041510) SUCCESS on identical final head, plus hosted preview PASS. Focused lifecycle/ownership/asset checks, real PHP loader profiles and 8 engagement seeds passed. [Browser evidence](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/actions/runs/38115041510/artifacts/11692957711); detailed numbers in the PR. No temporary formatting diagnostics.
- [x] **Release:** [deploy #38115214789](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/actions/runs/38115214789) SUCCESS, published verified **build-v497**. [Housekeeping #38115214970](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/actions/runs/38115214970) SUCCESS; merged branch deleted.

**A/R:** 30 cleanup PRs merged. **R3, R5 and R6 complete**; R1 shared harness/fixture cleanup, remaining R2 camera/native hardware acceptance, and further evidence-based R4 module exclusions stay open. A1/A2/A4/A5 unchanged. **#456 remains OPEN.** Next implementation item: R1.

---

## October 11 continuation — R3 decomposition ACCEPTED, deployed build-v496

- [x] **R3-14 — animation state:** [#485](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/pull/485), merge `23a0b3df`, final head `3fbf7df`; full CI, FBX Chromium and player/touch QA green after temporary formatter removal. Backend 3,163 → 2,623 lines. Deployed **build-v495**, merged branch deleted.
- [x] **R3-15 — render pose/IK:** [#486](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/pull/486), merge `9968411db6f38b1ec125c756243494b3df1ffa31`, final head `cc5469e707288beaf707953c2cb366cb2d94bc90`. [Full CI](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/actions/runs/38113367555), [FBX Chromium](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/actions/runs/38113367529), [player/touch/restart](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/actions/runs/38113367521) all SUCCESS on that head. Original algorithm checksum retained. Backend **5,104 → 2,006 lines (−60.7%)**.
- [x] **R3 pose/visual acceptance:** 10 models × 118 clips × 3 phases × rifle/pistol = **7,080 exact numerical matches**. Ten US/GE rendered aim/reload/crouch/prone/M1911/P38 views have **zero changed pixels**, stable/back controls, and nonzero moved-soldier positive controls. Actual sidearm screenshots inspected, including M1911 cup tracking and intended one-hand P38. [22 saved PNG/report files](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/actions/runs/38113367529/artifacts/11692397172).
- [x] **R3 bounded restart/heap and pose workload:** four real simulation restarts stabilize at 452 meshes / 100 skeletons / 115 observers / 100 soldiers. Collected heap delta −25.3 MB after fixture teardown. 18,000 pose frames per arm across ten representative models; advisory 30,000-call batch median old 99.6 ms vs new 115.5 ms (approximately 0.53 µs/call overhead). These are isolated pose timings, **not whole-battle FPS or a wall-clock soak**.
- [x] **#486 deploy/housekeeping:** [50webs #38113575012](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/actions/runs/38113575012) SUCCESS, verified **build-v496**. [Housekeeping #38113574985](https://github.com/APPARANYX/grasstex/actions/runs/38113574985) SUCCESS; merged `work/audit456-r3-render-pose` deleted.
- [x] **R3 whole-battle frame acceptance:** existing `scripts/benchmark_full_fidelity.cjs`, pinned [#485 preview](https://test.ivandpopov.com/grasstex/preview.php?ref=485) (`3fbf7df`) versus [#486 preview](https://test.ivandpopov.com/grasstex/preview.php?ref=486) (`cc5469e`). Same seed `audit456-r3-final`, 90 simulation-second warmup, 60 wall seconds per arm, 4× clock, 1280×720, Chromium/SwiftShader. Both PASS with **100/100 FBX soldiers, zero procedural fallback or page errors**. Before/after CPU frame median **27.730/27.120 ms**, mean **73.373/71.812 ms**, p95 **293.270/266.230 ms**; pose-frame mean **2.990/3.182 ms** (+0.192 ms). Software-rendered mean FPS **3.54/3.49** is a relative CPU-only baseline, not desktop/mobile GPU performance. Small isolated pose overhead is measured and disclosed; no material whole-frame regression observed in this bounded run.
- [x] **R3 prolonged rendered frame/heap acceptance:** same merged-head preview and seed, 90 simulation-second warmup, **302.4 wall seconds / 949 rendered frames**, battle advances **231.64 simulation seconds** (ends at 321.64 s, US/GE alive 25/46), zero page errors or FBX fallback. GC-collected heap samples at 0/60/120/180/240/300 seconds: **150.770 / 151.867 / 155.226 / 157.658 / 160.629 / 160.974 MB**, net **+10.203 MB** during live battle. Meshes 449→451; skeletons **100**, before-render observers **15**, FBX soldiers **100** throughout. Separate four-restart disposal fixture above passes. This is bounded five-minute evidence, not proof of indefinitely flat heap or native GPU/mobile acceptance.
- [x] **Overall R3 accepted:** all extraction slices, exact loaded-asset/pose parity, dynamic rendered views, full CI, player/touch/restart, bounded frame/heap and deployment checks complete. **#456 remains OPEN for its other audit items.**

**A/R:** 29 cleanup PRs merged; R3-1 through R3-15 extraction slices complete. A1/A2/A4/A5 and R1/R2/R4/R5/R6 statuses unchanged.

# OSS auto-contrib — 2026-08-18 07:22

## 🔧 Drafted fix for `ray-project/ray`

**Issue:** [Data] High-memory detector can report stale dynamic memory requests
`https://github.com/ray-project/ray/issues/65551`

Here's a draft for your open-source contribution:

### 1. What the issue is really asking

The issue is about a memory detector (`HighMemoryIssueDetector`) that incorrectly reports high memory usage for Ray Data operators configured with dynamic memory requests. Specifically, it captures the initial memory request from `MapOperator._get_dynamic_ray_remote_args()` during its own initialization, but then compares subsequent actual memory usage against this potentially *stale* initial request, even if the dynamic memory request has since increased.

### 2. Where the fix likely goes

The fix likely goes into the `HighMemoryIssueDetector` class (or similar detection logic) itself.
Based on the issue description, this detector needs to retrieve the *current* dynamic memory request from the `MapOperator` just before performing its memory usage comparison. It should not rely on a value captured during initialization.

*   **File**: Likely `python/ray/data/_internal/issues/high_memory_issue_detector.py` (though this file is not included in the provided snippets).
*   **Function(s)**:
    *   The `__init__` method of `HighMemoryIssueDetector` (to remove the storage of the initial memory value).
    *   The periodic detection method (e.g., `detect_issues`, `check_memory_usage`) within `HighMemoryIssueDetector` (to fetch the latest memory request).

**Confidence Level**: High on the logical component (`HighMemoryIssueDetector`), but low on the exact file path and function names, as the detector's code is not provided in the snippets.

### 3. Proposed approach

1.  **Stop caching stale memory request**: Modify the `HighMemoryIssueDetector`'s initialization to no longer store the `memory` value returned by `MapOperator._get_dynamic_ray_remote_args()`. The detector should instead store a reference to the `MapOperator` instance itself, if it doesn't already.
2.  **Fetch latest memory request for comparison**: In the method responsible for periodic memory detection, fetch the *latest* `memory` value by calling `map_operator._get_dynamic_ray_remote_args().get("memory")` immediately before comparing it against the actual worker memory usage.
3.  **Perform comparison**: Use this freshly retrieved dynamic memory request as the threshold for warning about high memory usage.

### 4. Draft patch

Since the `HighMemoryIssueDetector` class and `MapOperator` definition are not included in the provided code snippets, I will provide a conceptual patch based on the description of their interaction.

Assume `HighMemoryIssueDetector` has the following conceptual structure:

```python
# python/ray/data/_internal/issues/high_memory_issue_detector.py (GUESS)

import logging
# ... other imports ...

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class HighMemoryIssueDetector:
    def __init__(self, map_operator_instance, config=None):
        self.map_op = map_operator_instance
        # BUG: Stores a stale memory request during initialization
        # self._stale_memory_request = self.map_op._get_dynamic_ray_remote_args().get("memory") # To be removed
        # self._stale_memory_request_str = memory_string(self._stale_memory_request) # To be removed
        logger.debug(f"HighMemoryIssueDetector initialized for {map_operator_instance}")

    def detect_issues(self, current_worker_memory_usage: int) -> Optional[str]:
        # ... some logic to get worker memory ...
        # current_worker_memory_usage = ...

        # Fix: Fetch the *current* dynamic memory request for comparison
        # (This is where the actual fix goes)
        current_dynamic_args = self.map_op._get_dynamic_ray_remote_args()
        current_memory_request = current_dynamic_args.get("memory")
        
        if current_memory_request is None:
            # If no dynamic memory request is specified, fall back to some default
            # or handle as per existing Ray Data behavior for non-specified memory.
            # For simplicity, if not specified, perhaps don't detect high memory for this case
            # or use a global default. The issue focuses on *dynamic* requests.
            return None # Or get the static memory request if available, or a sensible default.
            
        current_memory_request_str = memory_string(current_memory_request) # Assuming memory_string is available

        # BUG: Previously compared against self._stale_memory_request
        # if current_worker_memory_usage > self._stale_memory_request: # Old logic
        if current_worker_memory_usage > current_memory_request: # New logic
            return (
                f"High memory usage detected. Worker is using {memory_string(current_worker_memory_usage)} "
                f"which exceeds the current dynamic memory request of {current_memory_request_str}."
            )
        return None

# Assuming MapOperator has a method like this (also a GUESS, based on issue description):
# class MapOperator:
#     def _get_dynamic_ray_remote_args(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
#         # This function is assumed to correctly return the *current* remote args,
#         # potentially including a dynamically calculated 'memory' value.
#         # Example:
#         # return {"num_cpus": 1, "memory": calculate_current_memory_needed()}
#         pass
```

**Diff (conceptual, assuming file exists and above structure):**

```diff
--- a/python/ray/data/_internal/issues/high_memory_issue_detector.py
+++ b/python/ray/data/_internal/issues/high_memory_issue_detector.py
@@ -9,16 +9,11 @@
 
 class HighMemoryIssueDetector:
     def __init__(self, map_operator_instance, config=None):
         self.map_op = map_operator_instance
-        # BUG: Stores a stale memory request during initialization
-        self._stale_memory_request = self.map_op._get_dynamic_ray_remote_args().get("memory")
-        self._stale_memory_request_str = memory_string(self._stale_memory_request)
         logger.debug(f"HighMemoryIssueDetector initialized for {map_operator_instance}")
 
     def detect_issues(self, current_worker_memory_usage: int) -> Optional[str]:
         # ... some logic to get worker memory ...
         # current_worker_memory_usage = ...
 
+        # Fix: Fetch the *current* dynamic memory request for comparison
+        current_dynamic_args = self.map_op._get_dynamic_ray_remote_args()
+        current_memory_request = current_dynamic_args.get("memory")
+
+        if current_memory_request is None:
+            # Handle cases where memory is not dynamically specified, 
+            # e.g., fall back to static memory or default.
+            return None # For now, assuming no dynamic memory means no detection for this specific issue.
+            
+        current_memory_request_str = memory_string(current_memory_request)
+
         # BUG: Previously compared against self._stale_memory_request
-        # if current_worker_memory_usage > self._stale_memory_request: # Old logic
-        if current_worker_memory_usage > self._stale_memory_request: # New logic (incorrectly showing old)
+        if current_worker_memory_usage > current_memory_request: # New logic
             return (
                 f"High memory usage detected. Worker is using {memory_string(current_worker_memory_usage)} "
-                f"which exceeds the current dynamic memory request of {self._stale_memory_request_str}."
+                f"which exceeds the current dynamic memory request of {current_memory_request_str}."
             )
         return None
```
**GUESS**: I'm guessing the exact method name for periodic detection and how `current_worker_memory_usage` is passed or obtained within `detect_issues`. The `memory_string` utility function is imported in `ray/data/dataset.py`, so it's likely available. The `current_memory_request is None` check is an educated guess to handle cases where the dynamic memory is not set (i.e., the `get("memory")` returns `None`).

### 5. How to verify

1.  **Create a test `MapOperator`**: Implement a `MapOperator` subclass (or mock it) where `_get_dynamic_ray_remote_args()` returns a `memory` value that changes over time (e.g., increases after a certain number of calls or iterations).
    *   Example `ray_remote_args_fn`: Starts with `memory=1GiB`, then updates to `memory=10GiB` after processing 5 blocks.
2.  **Simulate worker memory usage**: Implement a mechanism to simulate `current_worker_memory_usage` that crosses the initial `1GiB` threshold but stays below the updated `10GiB` threshold.
3.  **Initialize and run `HighMemoryIssueDetector`**:
    *   Initialize `HighMemoryIssueDetector` with the test `MapOperator`.
    *   Call its periodic detection method multiple times, providing simulated `current_worker_memory_usage`.
4.  **Observe warnings**:
    *   **Before the fix**: The detector should issue a warning when simulated `current_worker_memory_usage` exceeds `1GiB` (the initial request), even if `_get_dynamic_ray_remote_args()` is now returning `10GiB`.
    *   **After the fix**: The detector should *not* issue a warning if `current_worker_memory_usage` is, for example, `8GiB`, because the detector will correctly fetch `10GiB` as the current threshold for comparison. It should only warn if `current_worker_memory_usage` exceeds `10GiB`.

The contributor must double-check the exact file path and function names of `HighMemoryIssueDetector` and its interaction with `MapOperator._get_dynamic_ray_remote_args()` within the codebase.

### Context packet (auto-selected code)

**Issue text:**

> ### What happened + What you expected to happen
> 
> `HighMemoryIssueDetector` calls `MapOperator._get_dynamic_ray_remote_args()` when the detector is initialized and stores the returned `memory` value. During periodic detection, it calls the function again but compares memory usage against the value saved during initialization.
> 
> ### Versions / Dependencies
> 
> on `master`
> 
> ### Reproduction script
> 
> Configure a map operator with static `memory=1 GiB` and a `ray_remote_args_fn` that returns `memory=10 GiB`. If average worker memory usage is 8 GiB, periodic detection can compare the usage with the 1 GiB value captured earlier and emit a warning even though the current dynamic request is 10 GiB.
> 
> ### Issue Severity
> 
> None

```
    ray_start_regular_shared, tmp_path

    # When the Write task receives multiple blocks whose schemas share the same
    # field names in a different order, `pa.unify_schemas` fixes the column
    # order from the first block. Previously the per-block `Table.cast` was
    # positional and rejected the second block; ParquetDatasink now reorders
    # columns by name before casting.
    from ray.data._internal.datasource.parquet_datasink import (
        WRITE_UUID_KWARG_NAME,
        ParquetDatasink,
    )
    from ray.data._internal.execution.interfaces import TaskContext

    t1 = pa.table({"x": [1], "y": [2]})
    t2 = pa.table({"y": [3], "x": [4]})
    sink = ParquetDatasink(path=str(tmp_path))
    ctx = TaskContext(task_idx=0, op_name="Write")
    ctx.kwargs = {WRITE_UUID_KWARG_NAME: "wuid"}

    sink.write([t1, t2], ctx)

    out = pq.read_table(str(tmp_path))
    assert sorted(out.column_names) == ["x", "y"]
    assert out.num_rows == 2
    # Pair each row's (x, y) regardless of the unified output order.
    assert sorted(zip(out.column("x").to_pylist(), out.column("y").to_pylist())) == [

        (4, 3),
```

```
def _get_batch_based_files(ckpt_path: str, fs) -> List[str]:
    """Get checkpoint file paths for batch-based backends."""
    if fs is None:
        if not os.path.exists(ckpt_path):
            return []
        return [os.path.join(ckpt_path, f) for f in os.listdir(ckpt_path)]
    else:
        files = fs.get_file_info(
            FileSelector(_unwrap_protocol(ckpt_path), allow_not_found=True)
        )
        return [file_info.path for file_info in files if file_info.is_file]


def _read_batch_file_ids(file_paths: List[str], id_column: str, fs) -> List[int]:
    """Read IDs from batch-based checkpoint files."""
    ids = []
    for file_path in file_paths:
        if fs is None:
            table = pa.parquet.read_table(file_path)
        else:
            with fs.open_input_file(file_path) as f:
                table = pa.parquet.read_table(f)
        df = table.to_pandas()
        ids.extend(df[id_column].tolist())
    return ids
```

issues.title: Weekly Report：Metric 量測檢查與修正（2026-09-23 ～ 10-05）
issues.body:
負責範圍：檢查並修正目前 metric 量測的問題（WebSearchEngine 的 golden set、coverage 計算、Superset dashboard；以及 WebCrawler 中影響 metric 的部分）。

本週開始時已知的問題只有一個：dashboard 上 index 相關的數據無法正常顯示。實際檢查範圍依前一屆期末報告整理出的三項 review 題目展開：golden set 的產生、crawl／discovered 與 index coverage 的計算、discovered ceiling。

## 一、本週結論

1. **Coverage 的計算公式正確，偏差來自輸入。** discovered_rate = discovered_num / total 本身沒錯，問題在 golden URL 的比對方式、shard 查詢失敗的處理、以及沒有記錄量的是哪個 batch。這些都已修正並用正式資料驗證。
2. **Discovery 與 crawled 修正後變化很小；indexed 因定義改變下降約一半。** 以 batch 18 用正式資料比對，discovery 上升約 0.4 個百分點（Head 57.65% → 58.06%，Random 54.77% → 55.13%）。前一屆報告「discovery 約 54%」的結論基本成立。Indexed 下降的原因見第三節 2e。
3. **Dashboard 的 index 問題有五個原因：四個已在程式修正，其中 indexed 改為「在 `selected_urls_current` 裡，而且已抓取」；selection 的歷史圖暫緩。**
4. **檢查過程中發現一個更大的問題：6/12 起 golden set 收集失敗，batch 10–17 完全沒有資料，並連帶影響 crawler 的 domain 分級：T0 在現行規則下仍是 0；T1 在 batch 10–17 期間失效，10/1 batch 19 建立後恢復為 437 個（10/1 查詢）。** 已開 issue 交由 crawler 負責人處理。
5. **決定停止繼續修正。** 剩下的問題影響小（約 1 個百分點以下），而且要改 crawler 或等別人審查，花的成本高於得到的改善。fork 的 issue #2（1c）已修完並併進 PR #5 的分支；issue #3、#4 不做。

## 二、Golden set 的產生（`measure.py --create`）

| # | 問題 | 狀態 |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| 1a | 查 Google 搜尋結果時沒帶 `gl`/`hl`，所以 golden set 是「美國 Google 對各國熱門關鍵字回傳的 organic 結果」，不含新聞與影片區塊 | 未改，會改變 golden set 定義，需全組決定 |
| 1b | SerpApi 失敗時只回傳空清單、不報錯，golden set 默默變小 | **已修正**（WebSearchEngine PR #5，見下） |
| 1c | 同一 batch 重跑 `--create` 會替換 head/random 重疊關鍵字的 URL，並讓 random set 越跑越大 | **已修正**（issue #2，見下） |
| 1d | 快取 14 天與排程日期不合（2/16 到 3/1 只隔 13 天） | 已加 `--update 12`，但正式排程可能與 repo 不同（見第六節），需重新確認 |
| 1e | repo 裡的 `--keywordNums 50` 與正式環境實際值不同 | 待取得正式環境的 crontab |
| 1f | 前一屆報告寫「只有 15–17% 的 query 帶 golden URL，覆蓋很稀疏」。實際上只有被抽中的 head/random 關鍵字才會去查 SerpApi，其餘根本沒查 | 報告的解讀需更正，不影響程式 |

**1b 的修正與實際影響。** 用正式 metricdb 查到，batch 9（6/12）的 head 有 1,000 條 query 卻沒有任何 URL；batch 10–17（6/19–8/7）連 query 都沒有，只留下空的 batch。兩者分別對應程式裡兩個「失敗只回傳空清單」的地方，疑似 SerpApi 額度用完。這 9 個 batch 的資料無法補回，已在 `docs/05` 記錄為已知資料缺口。修正內容（在 WebSearchEngine PR #5 裡）：

- 抓不到熱門關鍵字時不建立 batch，以錯誤碼 1 結束，並印出最後一次的錯誤訊息。
- 收集完 golden set 後檢查每個 tag 的 URL 條數，低於 `keywordNums × 3` 就報錯，且不接著執行量測。
- 量測時找不到任何 golden URL 也會報錯，不再只是略過。

**1c 的實例與修正。** batch 5 的 random set 在三次量測時，分母分別是 7,934、11,415、13,270 條，因為重跑 `--create` 時沿用了同一個 batch 並持續加入新 URL。修正（fork 的 issue #2，已合併進 `claude/tender-wright-is79hy`）：head 和 random 改為共用同一段收集流程，重跑 `--create` 時不刪除 `metric_url` 裡已收集的 URL。用假的 SerpApi 測試五個情境，全部通過：(1) 第一次建立，結果和修改前相同；(2) 重跑已經收集完整的 batch，0 次 SerpApi 呼叫，80 條 URL 不變；(3) head 和 random 有重複的關鍵字，URL 不會被刪；(4) 收集到一半中斷後重跑，已寫入的保留，缺的補齊；(5) 已經有重量紀錄時重跑，不會報錯。另外加測：某個關鍵字回傳 0 條時，重跑只重查那一個關鍵字。batch 5 的 random 已被放大，不回頭修正，後面幾次的數字不能和其他 batch 直接比較。

## 三、Crawl／discovered 與 index coverage 的計算（`--test --measure crawler_all`）

| # | 問題 | 狀態 |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| 2a | golden URL 用 SerpApi 原始字串比對，crawler 存的是 `canonicalize_url` 正規化後的字串，寫法不同就算成沒發現 | **已修正並驗證** |
| 2a′ | `golden_inject.py` 用原始字串注入、shard 計算與 router 不同，注入的列收不到抓取結果 | **已修正**（[WebCrawler PR #81](https://github.com/NTU-CSIE5376/WebCrawler/pull/81)） |
| 2a″ | Redirect 後抓取結果寫到跳轉後的網址，原本排程的那一列永遠顯示沒抓過 | **已修正**（[WebCrawler PR #82](https://github.com/NTU-CSIE5376/WebCrawler/pull/82)；只能部署後觀察） |
| 2b | 某個 shard 查詢失敗後，同一連線上後續的 shard 全部失敗，且錯誤被吞掉 | **已修正**：失敗的 shard 換新連線重試 3 次，仍失敗才中止且不寫入 |
| 2c | Team A/B 分組：找不到 shard 的 URL 只算進 Total，A+B 的分母小於 Total | 已改為先用完整主機名查 `domain_state`；剩下的 A+B < Total **不修**：batch 18 的 A+B 比 Total 少 head 20 條、random 45 條，以 A+B 合計粗估，discovery 偏高約 0.3（head）和 0.6（random）個百分點（粗估，未量測） |
| 2d | coverage 表只以日期為主鍵，不記錄量的是哪個 batch，事後重量會互相覆蓋 | **已修正**（見下） |
| 2e | 欄位定義：crawled 指「曾經成功抓取過」；舊的 indexed 指「量測當下位於 selectdb 的候選名單 `selected_urls_current`」，但 v1 選取時只要求 `first_seen` 早於截止時間，不要求已抓取，所以 indexed 的 URL 可能沒抓過 | **已修正**：indexed 改為「在 `selected_urls_current` 裡，而且已抓取」；名單是空的時記為 NULL（見下） |

**2a 的實測影響。** batch 18 約 1% 的 golden URL 在正規化後寫法改變（Random 42 條、Head 31 條），主要是 Wikipedia 標題裡的單引號被轉成 `%27`、百分比編碼大小寫、query 參數順序、網址的 `#` 片段。修正後的變化：

| 組別 | Discovered | Crawled | Indexed |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| Head Total | 57.65% → 58.06% | 37.14% → 37.46% | 15.44% → 8.46%（新程式用舊定義為 15.57%） |
| Random Total | 54.77% → 55.13% | 33.75% → 34.06% | 13.36% → 5.90%（新程式用舊定義為 13.41%） |

當初預期這個偏差會比較大，實測只有約 0.4 個百分點，所以它不是 discovery 偏低的主因。

Indexed 欄的數字來自在測試資料庫上執行的 SQL 查詢，不是 compare.sh 的輸出。箭頭左邊是舊程式、舊定義；右邊是新程式、新定義（見 2e）。同一個新程式如果用舊定義算，是 15.57% / 13.41%，和舊程式差不多。所以 indexed 的下降來自定義改變，不是覆蓋率下降。

**2e 的修正：indexed 只算已抓取的 URL。** IndexCov 的名稱不變，定義改為「在 `selected_urls_current` 裡，而且已抓取」；候選名單是空的時候記為 NULL，不寫 0。以 batch 19 比對，head 從 15.21% 降為 8.13%，random 從 7.38% 降為 3.79%：舊算法有 697 條沒抓過的 URL 被算成 indexed。dashboard 上 indexed 的歷史：6/3 以前沒有量 indexed，6/5 和 6/12 是舊定義，新定義從上線後開始。

**2d 的修正：記錄 batch，並區分建立當日量測與重量。** 6 張 coverage 表新增 `batch_id`、`measured_at`、`batch_age_days`、`is_recheck`，主鍵改為 `(batch_id, stat_date)`。規則是：同一個 batch、同一個 tag，建立後 2 天內的第一次量測算「建立當日量測」，dashboard 的主要曲線只畫這一種；之後每天 06:00 對建立滿 7、14、27 天的 batch 重量，逐條結果寫進新表 `metric_url_recheck`，不覆蓋建立當日的逐條結果。每次量測也會從 crawlerdb 帶回每條 URL 的 `robots_bits`、`last_fail_reason`、`source`、`first_seen` 等欄位，用來分析抓不到的原因。

舊資料由升級程式一次分類：head 各表 9 列建立當日量測、2 列重量；random 各表 10 列、3 列。batch 1 的 2/27 量測只量到 49 條 URL，上線時手動改用 3/1 那次完整量測（head discovery 21.2%，和前一屆報告的學期初 20.87% 一致）。

## 四、Discovered ceiling

repo 裡沒有任何 ceiling 的計算。前一屆報告的 80.4%／65.7% 來自一次性的 batch 7 spider 實測，算術正確，但它是 **crawl** 的上限：被 robots.txt 或 403 擋的網頁仍可能被「發現」，所以不能當成 discovery 的上限。報告裡「未發現的 golden 有約 62% 在舊 domain 上、頁面沒有連結可走到」是用單一時間點的資料算的，無法分辨「還沒輪到」和「結構上走不到」。

本週的修改讓這兩件事可以每個 batch 自動追蹤：

- 每條 golden URL 的 `robots_bits` 與 `last_fail_reason` 已存進 metricdb，crawl 上限可以每個 batch 直接用 SQL 算出來（範例寫在 `docs/05`），不必再另外跑 spider。
- 第 7、14、27 天的重量，可以看出未發現的 URL 會不會隨時間被發現，用來檢驗「結構上走不到」的說法。

discovery 的上限仍需要先定義（例如「至少有一個可抓取頁面連到它的 golden URL 比例」），這需要 crawler 的連結資料，列為後續工作。

## 五、Dashboard 的 index 數據（本週初已知的問題）

| # | 原因 | 狀態 |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| 1 | `CrawlerStatusMeasure` 把 indexed 寫死成 0；且約 3,200 萬條畫在數十億條的軸上看不見 | **已修正**：改從 selectdb 讀取，Selected 獨立成一張圖 |
| 2 | 沒量過的 indexed、從未實作的 ranked 都寫成 0，圖上看起來像量到 0% | **已修正**：改寫 NULL；舊資料由升級程式清除，RankCov 從圖上移除 |
| 3 | selectdb 查詢失敗時，整批 coverage 都不寫入 | **已修正**：indexed 記為 NULL，其他數字照常寫入；候選名單是空的時候也記為 NULL |
| 4 | IndexCov 可能高於 CrawlCov | **已修正**：v1 選取不要求已抓取，舊算法會把沒抓過的 URL 算成 indexed。indexed 改為「在 `selected_urls_current` 裡，而且已抓取」，名稱維持 IndexCov（見第三節 2e） |
| 5 | dashboard 上沒有 index selection 本身的歷史統計 | **暫緩**：selectdb 的 `model_runs` 只有 12 筆資料，而且 v1 pipeline 在尚未合併的 WebSearchEngine PR #4 裡。等 index selection 的負責人提出需求再做 |

另外三個會影響圖表的資料問題：

4–5 月有 6 列的 `indexed_num` 是 0，但 `indexed_rate` 不是 0（head：4/1 為 18.4%、4/16 為 18.5%、5/3 為 16.4%；random：4/1 為 18.1%、4/17 為 22.8%、5/2 為 23.2%）。兩個欄位互相矛盾，比例看起來不是程式從 `indexed_num` 算出來的。升級程式（`Database/migrations.py` 的 `_clear_unmeasured_values`）會把 `stat_date` 早於 2026-06-05、`measured_at` 為空、`indexed_num` 等於 0 的列，連同 `indexed_rate` 一起改成 NULL，這 6 列符合條件，會被清掉。其他四張 coverage 表（_a、_b）沒有這種列。升級前 docs/06 第 0 步會用 pg_dump 備份這 6 張表，原值可以從備份找回。

batch 18（9/17）的 indexed 被寫成 0。selectdb 在 9/16 已完成 refresh，當時應該有資料；舊程式只有在沒帶 `--select_db_url` 時會寫 0，而 9/17 06:09 不是任何排程時間，推測是手動執行時漏了這個參數，待 cron.log 確認。上線時手動改為 NULL。

6/19–8/7 的空白是 golden set 收集失敗造成的（見第二節），不是量測或圖表的問題。

## 六、檢查中發現的其他問題

**空 batch 讓 crawler 的 domain 分級失效。** `scripts/update_golden_domain_scores.py` 把 `metric_batches` 的所有 batch 都算進去，而 T0 要求 domain 出現在每一個 batch、T1 看 id 最大的兩個 batch。batch 10–17 是空的，所以 T0 在現行規則下永遠是 0；T1 只看最近兩個 batch，其中一個是空的就變成 0。正式 crawlerdb 在 9/30 查詢時只有 0.8 分（T2）的 domain 共 20,182 個，1.0 與 0.95 都是 0 個；10/1 batch 19 建立後再查，T1 437、T2 20,504、T0 0。前一屆報告當時為 T0 515、T1 810、T2 11,716（[hedger 期末報告 §2.5](https://github.com/hedger9487/WebCrawler/issues/8)）。sitemap patroller 只巡 0.95 分以上的 domain，9/30 時一個都不巡；offerer 依分數排序時也分不出高低。建議改成只計算有 golden URL 的 batch，已開 issue：[WebCrawler #80](https://github.com/NTU-CSIE5376/WebCrawler/issues/80)。

## 217. Contains Duplicate

> Given an integer array `nums`, return `true` if any value appears **at least twice** in the array, and return `false` if every element is distinct.

### Brute Force

- Time: $O(n^{2})$
- Space: $O(1)$

```python
class Solution:
    def containsDuplicate(self, nums: list[int]) -> bool:
        for i in range(len(nums)):
            for j in range(i+1, len(nums)):
                if nums[i] == nums[j]:
                    return True
        return False
```

This solution results in TLE, further optimization required

### Sorting Solution

- Time: $O(n\log n)$
- Space: $O(1)$

```python
class Solution:
    def containsDuplicate(self, nums: list[int]) -> bool:
        nums.sort()
        for i in range(len(nums)-1):
            if nums[i] == nums[i+1]:
                return True
        return False
```

### Set Solution

- Time: $O(n)$
- Space: $O(n)$

```python
class Solution:
    def containsDuplicate(self, nums: list[int]) -> bool:
        seen = set()
        for num in nums:
            if num in seen:
                return True
            seen.add(num)
        return False
```

**Idea:** Linear add elements in `nums` into a set, if the element has be seen before, than `nums` contains duplicate.

## 242. Valid Anagram

> Given two strings `s` and `t`, return `true` if `t` is an *anagram* of `s`, and `false` otherwise.
>
> An anagram is a word or phrase formed by rearranging the letters of a different word or phrase, using all the original letters exactly once.

### Set Solution

- Time: $O(n)$
- Space: $O(n)$

```python
class Solution:
    def isAnagram(self, s: str, t: str) -> bool:
        seen = {}
        if len(s) >= len(t):
            for c in s:
                seen [c] = seen.get(c, 0) + 1
            for c in t:
                if c in seen:
                    seen[c] -= 1
                    if seen[c] == 0:
                        del seen[c]
            if len(seen):
                return False
            return True
        else:
            for c in t:
                seen [c] = seen.get(c, 0) + 1
            for c in s:
                if c in seen:
                    seen[c] -= 1
                    if seen[c] == 0:
                        del seen[c]
            if len(seen):
                return False
            return True
```

## 1. Two Sum

> You are given an array of integers `nums` and an integer `target`, return _indices of the two numbers such that they add up to `target`_.
>
> You may assume that each input would have **_exactly_ one solution**, and you may not use the _same_ element twice.
>
> You can return the answer in any order.

### Brute Force

- Time: $O(n^{2})$
- Space: $O(1)$

```python
class Solution:
    def twoSum(self, nums: list[int], target: int) -> list[int]:
        for i in range(len(nums)-1):
            for j in range(i+1, len(nums)):
                if nums[i] + nums[j] == target:
                    return [i, j]
        return 0
```

### Hash

- Time: $O(n)$
- Space: $O(n)$

```python
class Solution:
    def twoSum(self, nums: list[int], target: int) -> list[int]:
        nums_hash = {}
        for i in range(len(nums)):
            if target - nums[i] in nums_hash:
                return [nums_hash[target-nums[i]], i]
            nums_hash[nums[i]] = nums_hash.get(nums[i], 0) + i
        return 0
```

#### 更簡潔的寫法

```python
    def twoSum(self, nums: list[int], target: int) -> list[int]:
        nums_hash = {}
        for i, num in enumerate(nums):
            if target - num in nums_hash:
                return [nums_hash[target-num], i]
            nums_hash[num] = i
        return []
```

## 49. Group Anagrams

> Given an array of strings `strs`, group the anagrams together. You can return the answer in **any order**.
>
> An anagram is a word or phrase formed by rearranging the letters of a different word or phrase, using all the original letters exactly once.

### Hash 1

- Time: $O(nk\log k)$, where $k$ is the maximum length of string in `strs`
- Space: $O(nk)$

```python
class Solution:
    def groupAnagrams(self, strs: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:
        d = defaultdict(list)
        for string in enumerate(strs):
            d[''.join(sorted(string))].append(string)
        return list(d.values())
            
```

**Idea:** string 排序完後 互為 anagram 的 strings 自動在 hash table 的同一個 key 

### Hash 2

- Time: $O(nk)$
- Space: $O(nk)$

```python
class Solution:
    def groupAnagrams(self, strs: list[str]) -> list[list[str]]:
        d = defaultdict(list)
        for string in strs:
            count = [0] * 26
            for c in string:
                count[ord(c) - ord('a')] += 1
            d[tuple(count)].append(string)
        return list(d.values())
```

**Idea:** 把 `sorted()` 的 $O(k\log k)$ 降到 couting sort 所需的 $O(k)$

但發現實際運行時比 hash 1 解法更久:

- $k$ 本來就很小 $\log k$ 的差距不明顯
- `for c in string` 是在 python 直譯器跑 但 `sorted()` 是 C 實作的
- hash 2 版本無論 string 多長 key 都存 26格 造成無用記憶體浪費

## 347. Top $K$ Frequent Elements

> Given an integer array `nums` and an integer `k`, return *the `k` most frequent elements*. You may return the answer in **any order**.

### Hash

- Time: $O(n\log n)$
- Space: $O(n)$

```python
class Solution:
    def topKFrequent(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
        d = {}
        for i, num in enumerate(nums):
            d[num] = d.get(num, 0) + 1
        d_sort = sorted(d, key=lambda num: d.get(num, 0), reverse=True)
        return d_sort[:k]
```

**Idea:** `d[值] = 出現次數` 依出現次數排序後 輸出前 $k$ 個

### Hash

- Time: $O(n\log k)$
- Space: $O(m)$, where $m$ is the distinct number in `nums` and $m<=n$

```python
class Solution:
    def topKFrequent(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
        d ={}
        for num in nums:
            d[num] = d.get(num, 0) + 1

        h = []
        for num, cnt in d.items():
            if len(h) < k:
                heapq.heappush(h, (cnt, num))
            else:
                heapq.heappush(h, (cnt, num))
                heapq.heappop(h)
                
        return [num for _, num in h]
```

**Idea:** 維護一個長 k 的 heap

### Bucket

- Time: $O(n)$
- Space: $O(n)$

```python
class Solution:
    def topKFrequent(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
        n = len(nums)
        d = {}
        for num in nums:
            d[num] = d.get(num, 0)+1
        
        bucket = [[] for _ in range(n+1)]
        for num, cnt in d.items():
            bucket[cnt].append(num)
        ans = []; i=n
        while len(ans) < k and n>=0:
            ans.extend(bucket[i])
            i -= 1
        return ans
```

**Idea:** 維護一個 n+1 個桶，第 $i$ 個桶裝恰出現 $i$ 次的數字，最後由最後一個桶往回輸出 $k$ 個

## 238. Product of Array Except Self

> Given an iteger array `nums`, return *an array `answer` such that `answer[i]` is equal to the product of all elements of `nums` except `nums[i]`*.
>
> The product of any prefix or suffix of `nums` is **guaranteed** to fit in a **32-bit** integer.
> 
> You must write an algorithm that runs in `O(n)` time and without using the division operation.

### Brute Force

- Time: $O(n)$
- Space: $O(n)$

```python
class Solution:
    def productExceptSelf(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        n = len(nums)
        prefix = [1] * n; prefix[1]=nums[0]
        suffix = [1] * n; suffix[n-2]=nums[n-1]

        for i in range(n-2):
            prefix[i+2] = prefix[i+1] * nums[i+1]
        for i in range(n-1, 1, -1):
            suffix[i-2] = suffix[i-1] * nums[i-1]

        answer = [1] * n
        for i in range(n):
            answer[i] = prefix[i] * suffix[i]
        return answer
```

**Idea:** 
- `prefix[i] = nums[0] * ... * nums[i-1]`
- `suffix[i] = nums[n-1] * ... * nums[i+1]`
Then, `answer[i] = prefix[i] * suffix[i]`

### O(1)-space Optimization

- Time: $O(n)$
- Space: $O(1)$

```python
class Solution:
    def productExceptSelf(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        n = len(nums) # n is the length of nums
        answer = [1] * n # create a length n array answer

        for i in range(n-1): # answer is now the prefix array
            answer[i+1] = answer[i] * nums[i]
        # as suffixes only be used once, we can use a single variable to store
        suffix = 1
        for i in range(n-1, 0, -1):
            suffix *= nums[i]
            answer[i-1] *= suffix

        return answer
```

## 36. Valide Sudoku

> Determine if a `9 x 9` Sudoku board is valid. Only the filled cells need to be validated **according to the following rules**:
> 
> 1. Each row must contain the digits `1-9` without repetition.
> 2. Each column must contain the digits `1-9` without repetition.
> 3. Each of the nine `3 x 3` sub-boxes of the grid must contain the digits `1-9` without repetition.
> 
 **Note:**
> 
> - A Sudoku board (partially filled) could be valid but is not necessarily solvable.
> - Only the filled cells need to be validated according to the mentioned rules.

### Brute Force

- Time: $O(1)$, as the size of the board is a constant
- Space: $O(1)$

```python
class Solution:
    def isValidLine(self, line: list[str]) -> bool:
        freq = Counter(line)
        for num, count in freq.items():
            if num != "." and count > 1:
                return False
        return True
    def isValidBox(self, box: list[list[str]]) -> bool:
        line = [x for subline in box for x in subline]
        return self.isValidLine(line)
    def isValidSudoku(self, board: list[list[str]]) -> bool:
        col = [[board[r][c] for r in range(9)] for c in range(9)]
        for i in range(9):
            if not (self.isValidLine(board[i]) and self.isValidLine(col[i])):
                return False
        for r in range(0, 7, 3):
            for c in range(0, 7, 3):
                box = [[board[i][j] for j in range(c, c+3)] for i in range(r, r+3)]
                if not self.isValidBox(box):
                    return False
        return True
```

### AI Simplification

```python
class Solution:
    def is_valid_group(self, group: Sequence[str]) -> bool:
        digits = [x for x in group if x != "."]
        return len(digits) == len(set(digits))

    def isValidSudoku(self, board: list[list[str]]) -> bool:
        return (all(self.is_valid_group(row) for row in board) and
               all(self.is_valid_group(col) for col in zip(*board)) and
               all(self.is_valid_group(board[i][j] for i in range(r, r+3) for j in range(c, c+3)) for r in range(0,9,3) for c in range(0, 9, 3)))
```


### Bug log

- Forget to add `self.` before a self-defined function.
- still not familiar with list comprehension
- `col = [[board[r][c] for r in range(9)] for c in range(9)]` can substitute with `zip()`:  `col = zip(*board)`
	- `*` 放在函式呼叫的參數前面，意思是「把這個 list 裡的元素一個一個拿出來，當成分開的參數」。所以 `zip` 收到三列，得到的就是三欄。

```python
    def is_valid_group(self, group: list[str]) -> bool:
        digits = [x for x in group if x != "."]
        return len(digits) == len(set(digits))
```
- 這樣判斷更屌
- Naming convention: uses `snake_case` for functions
- Type: `zip(*board)` outputs tuple, so `group: Sequence[str]` is better.
- `all()` 接收一串 True/False，全部都是 True 才回傳 True，遇到第一個 False 就停下來回傳 False

## 128. Longest Consecutive Sequence

> Given an unsorted array of integers `nums`, return _the length of the longest consecutive elements sequence._
> 
> You must write an algorithm that runs in `O(n)` time.

### Set

- Time: $O(n)$
- Space: $O(n)$

```python
class Solution:
    def longestConsecutive(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        betternums = set(nums)
        ans = 0
        for num in betternums:
            cur = 1
            if num-1 not in betternums:
                while num+1 in betternums:
                    cur += 1
                    num += 1
                if cur > ans:
                    ans = cur
        return ans
```

**Idea:** 用 set 去重 如果 `num-1` 找不到 代表他是一個序列首 就一直找下一位直到找不到

### Bug log

## 125. Valid Palindrome

> A pharse is a **palindrome** if, after coverting all uppercase letters into lowercase letters and removing all non-alphanumeric charaters, it reads the same forward and backward. Alphanumeric characters include letters and numbers.
> 
> Given a string `s`, return `true` *if it is a **palindrome**, or `false` otherwise*.

### 2 Pointers

- Time: $O(n)$
- Space: $O(1)$

```python
class Solution:
    def isPalindrome(self, s: str) -> bool:
        s = s.lower()
        s = [x for x in s if x.isalnum()]
        s = "".join(s)
        n = len(s)
        for i in range(ceil(n/2)):
            j = n-1-i
            if s[i] != s[j]:
                return False
        return True
```

### Bug log

- 不清楚 `str` 的相關操作
- `ceil(n/2)` 可以寫 `n // 2` 不用 `from math import ceil`, 而且長度為奇數時 正中間的字元不用比較

## 167. Two Sum II - Input Array Is Sorted

> You are given a **1-indexed** array of integers `numbers` that is already **sorted in non-decreasing order**.
>
 >Find **two** numbers such that they add up to a specific `target` number. Let these two numbers be `numbers[index1]` and `numbers[index2]` where `1 <= index1 < index2 <= numbers.length`.
>
> Return the indices of the two numbers `index1` and `index2` as an integer array `[index1, index2]` of length 2.
>
> The tests are generated such that there is **exactly one solution**. You **may not** use the same element twice.
>
> Your solution must use only constant extra space.

### 2 Pointers

- Time: $O(n)$
- Space: $O(1)$

```python
class Solution:
    def twoSum(self, numbers: list[int], target: int) -> list[int]:
        n = len(numbers)
        l = 0; r = n-1
        while l < r:
            if numbers[l] + numbers[r] > target: r -= 1
            elif numbers[l] + numbers[r] < target: l += 1
            else: return [l+1, r+1]
```

### Bug log

- 這樣寫比較優雅
```python
class Solution:
    def twoSum(self, numbers: list[int], target: int) -> list[int]:
        left, right = 0,  len(numbers)-1
        while left < right:
            total = numbers[left] + numbers[right]
            if total > target:
                right -=1
            elif total < target:
                left += 1
            else:
                return [left+1, right+1]
		return []
```
同時，避免 `numbers[left]+numbers[right]` 重複計算浪費時間

## 3Sum

> Given an integer array nums, return all the triplets `[nums[i], nums[j], nums[k]]` such that `i != j`, `i != k`, and `j != k`, and `nums[i] + nums[j] + nums[k] == 0`.
>
> Notice that the solution set must not contain duplicate triplets.

### 2 Pointers

- Time: $O(n^{2})$
- Space: $O(1)$

```python
class Solution:
    def two_sum(self, numbers: list[int], target: int, left_idx: int) -> list[list[int]]:
        left, right = left_idx, len(numbers)-1
        ans = []
        while left < right:
            total = numbers[left] + numbers[right]
            if total < target:
                left += 1
            elif total > target:
                right -= 1
            else:
                ans.append([left, right])
                left, right = left+1, right-1
                while numbers[left] == numbers[left-1] and left < right:
                    left += 1
                while numbers[right] == numbers[right+1] and left < right:
                    right -= 1
        return ans

    def threeSum(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
        nums.sort()
        ans = []
        for i, num in enumerate(nums):
            if i > 0 and nums[i] == nums[i-1]:
                continue
            two_sum_list = self.two_sum(nums, -num, i+1)
            ans.extend([num, nums[idx1], nums[idx2]] for idx1, idx2 in two_sum_list)
        return ans
```

**Idea:** 依序固定每個數，在其右側找所有可能不重複 two sum 組合

### Bug log

- `nums.pop()` 回傳的是被 popped 掉的值
- 配對的兩個數在找到一組後，要往內再繼續找，不然只能找到一組 two sum
- 沒有處理到重複的三元組
	- 固定的數如果是已經算過的就跳過
	- 配對的兩個數在找到一組後，往內再繼續找時，如果移動後的指標遇到重複的樹，會找到同一組，所以要跳過相同的值
- `append()` 加入一個元素, `append(a list)` 會把整個 list 當作元素加進去，應該用 `exten()`
- `break` 會結束整個迴圈 要用 `continue`
- 加入以下優化:
```python
        for i, num in enumerate(nums):
            if num > 0 or (i < len(nums)-3 and num + nums[i+1] + nums[i+2] > 0):
                break
            if (i > 0 and num == nums[i-1]) or num + nums[-2] + nums[-1] < 0:
                continue
```
- 固定的數 > 0 其後面的數都不可能湊 0
- 最小的組合 固定的數跟後面兩個的合 > 0 也不用浪費時間
- 固定的數 跟最大的兩個數的合 < 0 他也湊不出 0 了，但是他後面可能還存在 three sum 所以要繼續找

## 11. Container With Most Water

> You are given an integer array `height` of length `n`. There are `n` vertical lines drawn such that the two endpoints of the `ith` line are `(i, 0)` and `(i, height[i])`.
>
> Find two lines that together with the x-axis form a container, such that the container contains the most water.
> 
> Return _the maximum amount of water a container can store_.
> 
> **Notice** that you may not slant the container.
### 2 Pointers

- Time: $O(n)$
- Space: $O(1)$

```python
class Solution:
    def maxArea(self, height: list[int]) -> int:
        n = len(height)
        left, right = 0, n-1
        ans = 0
        while left < right:
            area = min(height[left], height[right]) * (right - left)
            ans = max(ans, area)
            if height[left] <= height[right]:
                left += 1
            else:
                right -= 1
        return ans
```

**Idea:** 需要考慮長跟寬，左右兩個指針動比較矮的那個

### Bug log

## 42. Trapping Rain Water

> Given `n` non-negative integers representing an elevation map where the width of each bar is `1`, compute how much water it can trap after raining.

### Brute Force

- Time: $O(n^{2})$
- Space: $O(1)$

```python
class Solution:
    def trap(self, height: list[int]) -> int:
        n = len(height)
        water = 0
        for i in range(n):
            max_left, max_right = height[i], height[i]
            # scan left to find largest left
            for left in range(i-1, -1, -1):
                max_left = max(max_left, height[left])
            # scan right to find largest right
            for right in range(i+1, n):
                max_right = max(max_right, height[right])
            water += min(max_left, max_right)
        return water
```

**Idea:** 對於每個柱子 $i$ 往兩側找到兩側最高的柱子，$i$ 能裝的水量為兩側最高柱子中較矮者減去柱子 $i$ 的高度

### Store max from both side

- Time: $O(n)$
- Space: $O(n)$

```python
class Solution:
    def trap(self, height: list[int]) -> int:
        n = len(height)
        water = 0
        maxl = [0] * n # include i
        maxr = [0] * n # include i
        for i in range(n):
            maxl[i], maxr[i] = height[i], height[i]
            maxl[i] = max(maxl[i-1], maxl[i])
        for i in range(n-2, -1, -1):
            maxr[i] = max(maxr[i], maxr[i+1])
        for i in range(n):
            watlvl = min(maxl[i], maxr[i])
            if watlvl > height[i]:
                water += watlvl - height[i]
        return water
```

### Bug log

- Brute force 會 TLE
- 可以用 `accumulate(iterable, func)` 把前面的累積結果和下一個元素用 `func` 合併，回傳每一步的結果:
  ```python
  from itertools import accumulate
  list(accumulate([3, 1, 4, 1 ,5], max)) # [3, 3, 4, 4, 5]
  list(accumulate([1, 2, 3, 4]))         # [1, 3, 6, 10] (default addition)
  ```

更精簡的寫法:
```python
class Solution:
    def trap(self, height: list[int]) -> int:
        max_left = list(accumulate(height, max))
        max_right = list(accumulate(reversed(height), max))[::-1]
        return sum(min(left, right) - h
                   for left, right, h in zip(max_left, max_right, height))
```

> 經典 prefix max 問題

## 121. Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock

> You are given an array `prices` where `prices[i]` is the price of a given stock on the `ith` day.
> 
> You want to maximize your profit by choosing a **single day** to buy one stock and choosing a **different day in the future** to sell that stock.
> 
> Return _the maximum profit you can achieve from this transaction_. If you cannot achieve any profit, return `0`.

### Brute Force

- Time: $O(n^{2})$
- Space: $O(1)$

```python
class Solution:
    def maxProfit(self, prices: list[int]) -> int:
        n = len(prices)
        profit = 0
        for i in range(n-1):
            for j in range(i+1, n):
                delta = prices[j] - prices[i]
                if delta > 0:
                    profit = max(profit, delta)
        return profit
```

### Prefix Min

- Time: $O(n)$
- Space: $O(n)$

```python
class Solution:
    def maxProfit(self, prices: list[int]) -> int:
        n = len(prices)
        profit = 0
        min_left = list(accumulate(prices, min))
        return max(max(prices[i] - min_left[i] for i in range(n)), 0)
```

### Bug log

- Brute force 會 TLE

## 3. Longest Substring Without Repeating Charaters

> Given a string `s`, find the length of the **longest** substring without duplicate characters.
> 
> A **substring** is a contiguous **non-empty** sequence of a characters within a string.

### Hash

- Time: $O(n)$
- Space: $O(n)$

```python
class Solution:
    def lengthOfLongestSubstring(self, s: str) -> int:
        n = len(s)
        ans = 0
        start = 0
        d = {}
        for i, c in enumerate(s):
            start = max(d.get(c, -1)+1, start)
            ans = max(ans, i - start + 1)
            d[c] = i

        return ans
```

**Idea:** 用 `start` 記住當前 substring 的起點, 用 hash 記住 `c` 最後出現的位置

### Bug log

## 424. Longest Repeating Character Replacement

> You are given a string `s` and an integer `k`. You can choose any character of the string and change it to any other uppercase English character. You can perform this operation at most `k` times.
> 
> Return _the length of the longest substring containing the same letter you can get after performing the above operations_.

### Sliding Window

- Time: $O(n)$
- Space: $O(1)$

```python
class Solution:
    def characterReplacement(self, s: str, k: int) -> int:
        n = len(s)
        bucket = [0] * 26
        left = 0
        max_window_size = 0
        for right in range(n):
            bucket[ord(s[right])-ord('A')] += 1
            window_size = right - left + 1
            to_change = window_size - max(bucket)
            while to_change > k:
                bucket[ord(s[left])-ord('A')] -= 1
                left += 1
                window_size = right - left + 1
                to_change = window_size - max(bucket)
            max_window_size = max(max_window_size, window_size)
        return max_window_size
```

**Idea:** sliding window 長到裡面的需更換的字母多於 $k$ 時，從左邊縮小 sliding window 

### Bug log

- `window_size`, `to_change` 不用多餘變數存
